description: List the schedules of a Discord bot (restart, start, stop, console command, backup) with cron, timezone, next and last run. Bot owner only. Only schedules whose action the credential may manage are listed. `runOnceAt` set = one-time schedule: it runs once at that local time in `timezone` (`runOnceAtUtc` = same instant in UTC; its `cron` is only that minute, not a yearly repeat); `runOnceStatus` is pending, done (it ran, see lastRunAt) or expired (time passed without a successful run). Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

serviceId.description: ID of the Discord bot: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_discord_bots (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

name: list_discord_bot_schedules
title: List Discord Bot Schedules
